reviews.text:
For over 11 years Stuart was our dog’s  vet.  We would go between the Holland Road and the Lichfield Road Practice to see Stuart because of the trust he had built up with our dog Lottie who needed regular injections.  She was a nervous dog and Stuart always made time for her, fussing over her and calming her down.
Sadly she recently passed away but the whole family would like to say a huge thank you to Stuart for the years of care he gave to her and the compassion he gave to all of us on the day she sadly passed away.

Rather than supporting continued quality of life, this veterinary prefers to put our loved ones down. I would score -5 stars if I could.

They put my girl to sleep when I was out of the country even though I was on my flight back home... they refused to wait the 30ish hours it would have taken for me to get there.

They denied my chance to ever hold or see her alive again... The last person she saw should, have been me. Not a 2-bit Vet who had no heart to help her.
Very caring and very understanding. Couldn't ask for a more
Very good staff, profesional and friendly 🐈‍⬛🐈🐕🐕‍🦺🐇🐁😉🙃🙂 …
Amazing experience. Saved my cat after he was run over. ❤️

Nearly killed my dog had to rush her to a ‘DIFFERENT’ vet and pay £3000!!! For them to save her life and then another £700 to keep her another night then when she came home she couldn’t come up stairs for a week so someone always had to sleep down with her and if you think it might have been a hard operation it was a plain average spaying DO NOT BRING YOUR DOG TO THIS VET!!!!

All the staff are very friendly, polite and professional. The vets really take their time to explain clearly about your pets condition and the options for treatment. The staff are patient and kind with your pets.
Outstanding people. Independent privately owned clinic offering first class services. Contact with complete confidence.

My parents have taken our animals to this clinc for 10 years at least. They always take such great care of the animals. We took our family dog recently to say goodbye and Stuart was excellent. Friendly, kind and personable. Truly couldn't have asked for a better experience in such a vulnerable time. Thanks again, Stuart.
Perfect. Steve and his nurses are the kindest, most caring and most knowledgeable animal professionals you could hope to find. I cannot praise their care highly enough. Thank you.
Good place for your pets , friendly and fair prices .
Took great care of my cat, appt late due to emergencies ahead of mine but still scene within reasonable time
Such a brilliant practice with the loveliest staff, they always take such good care of our cats. Very highly recommended.

BEWARE !Not very happy at all.  They were happy to take the fee for cat health check and boosters a bit early,  but when I did not want a £300 blood test they suggested for my 19 year old cat , suddenly they were not interested in doing my cat booster early !!
After many many years with this cat and others before I shall not be returning to do it all again in 4 weeks time just so they can claim another fee.
Maybe they thought I was so old now I'd be intimidated :(
Be very aware.
I did phone back to confirm my understanding that I would be paying again in 4 weeks for something I had taken my cat for a few days ago  and YES I am correct. They want to charge again.
Not trustworthy at all.
Our local vet for our smallest and oldest member of the family. Fantastic service. Personal. Timely.

Awful service. Was told spade my cat would be normal price, but if she had a hernia, it would be an extra £70. I luckly asked for it to be sent in writing, and the bill would have come to over £700. Also the chip they put in didn't work. I'm now with The Veterinary Clinic in New Hall. Amazing job and no hidden costs.
Really compassionate, lovely and helpful. Got me in the same day and dealt with my issue quickly and kindly

Our elderly cavalier has a heart murmur and we might have needed a scan (expensive). We had agreed to the cost but Vet Steve said she is not bad enough to need it yet and charged us NOTHING. What great ethics and care. Thank you so very much. We changed from a vet owned by VC’s to Ashfield and have not regretted it for a single moment. Wonderful animal people
Staff very friendly and helpful.

As much as the actual care is good, the communication side of things is awful.  Any email we sent for repeat prescriptions was never answered so we always had to chase with a phone call.

Unfortunately when our dog passed away we informed them by email and didn't even get a 'sorry to hear...' reply or anything.

They pride themselves on being a private, family business but don't reply to Google reviews like most private firms do.  Maybe some extra training on the admin/communication side of things is required to boost this otherwise great animal surgery.
